summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys are having a leisure time at Yujiro Tamaki's bookstore café when a woman named Ami Komachi enters the bookstore. As part of a recent purchase of used books by the bookstore, a novel called "The Lonely Sea," one of Ami Komachi's father's keepsakes, was accidentally sold to the bookstore. Ami asks if she could buy the book back, but unfortunately, the book was already sold to another customer.
